name: com.realdegrees.meshblend
description: Soft contacts for URP: softens the hard line where one surface meets another (a rock entering the terrain, a wall standing on the ground) with a screen-space post effect. No changes to materials, meshes or URP.

samples.description: A rock cluster on grass, dirt and sand with CC0 textures, rocks clipping into each other and the ground at many angles, the blend set up on a volume. Needs the renderer feature and rendering layers from the README's setup (layers 1, 2 and 3).
